name: Snowblind Campground
evidence: Esri z19 frames: spur-end site with table ~18 m across open leafless willow from the creek, south spurs ~10-25 m; channel ~3-5 m (under 30 m, so creekside). No canopy screen on that side. rec.gov (scan-and-pay placeholder) and FS have no site photos or per-site data.

name: South Fork Campground
evidence: Esri z19 frames, creek pools ~5-8 m: west-side spur holds a tent ~10 m and a camper ~15 m from the creek over open dirt with a few trees; another spur ~15-25 m. Prior 150-200 m is wrong. rec.gov text 'next to South Fork Creek'. No site map or photos; spurs not tied to numbered sites and may be the group area, so held at riverview.

name: Stunner Campground
evidence: Esri z19 + USGS topo: Alamosa ~8-18 m, under the 30 m size; loop and turnaround ~50-70 m from it through a spruce belt, open meadow reaches it only at 150 m+. No official photos or site map; Outdoorithm's review-derived 'fifth site has a river view' is aggregator only, so it resolves down.

name: Storm King Campground
evidence: Esri z17 + z19: open grass and brown riparian, not the 'continuous forest' of prior evidence; channel only ~1-2 m. One vehicle on a two-track ~5-10 m from it, other campers ~40-90 m; pads not legible, so no site can be counted. FS says only 'stream is close by'; no photos or site map. Not earned, default down.

name: The Gate Campground (Lake Fork of the Gunnison)
evidence: All 23 rec.gov photos viewed; all 8 sites tagged Riverfront. Esri z18-19 channel ~7-20 m bank to bank, ~26 m at the bridge overall, under 30 m, so creekside. Earned at site 6 (31 ft, table on the bank, ~12-15 m), 4-5 (24-30 ft, ~25-35 m open grass). Site 3 (18 ft) does not count; 1, 7, 8 show no water.

name: Transfer Park Campground
evidence: 8 rec.gov photos viewed: none from a site shows water; the 'double site along Florida River' photo shows open pines only, and the canyon photo shows the river below rock walls. Esri z19: river ~5-10 m in a rock canyon, under 30 m; main loops ~100-200 m off in meadow and conifers. FS: 'above the Florida River'. Climb-down; prior 500 m is wrong.

name: Tabor Campground
evidence: Esri z19: upper lot (pin) ~65 m from beach behind lodgepole; lower lot's lake row ~15-25 m from the sand behind a conifer strip, open only at a gap by the boat ramp, so treeline bars on-water. Campers visible in lower lot; Dyrt reviews call it camping with water views. No official site photos; campsitephotos.com refused. Lower lot use rests on reviews.

name: Tunnel Campground
evidence: Esri z17 + z19 frames: Laramie River branches ~3-8 m, under 30 m, so creekside. South loop end ~15 m from channel and RV pad ~25 m across low green willow, no tree screen; a second occupied pad ~35 m from the channel. FS: at the West Branch/Laramie River confluence. FS-only, no site photos or map; on-water rests on imagery.
